DevicesMFE.py.class_summary: DevicesMFE is a page object class extending SmartFlow that provides comprehensive automation methods for the HP Smart Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) interface. The class implements verification flows for UI elements (popups, navigation, device cards, login state) and action flows for user interactions (clicking buttons, refreshing page, navigating multi-screen popups). Notable patterns include: (1) Flexible verification methods with configurable timeouts and exception handling, (2) JavaScript executor usage for hidden element interactions, (3) Keyboard automation for page refresh, (4) Multi-screen popup navigation support with dedicated methods for each screen, (5) Alpha testing workarounds for dummy printer devices, (6) Negative verification patterns using invisible element checks for login state, and (7) Wait-then-extract patterns for text content retrieval. The class uses string-based locator identifiers passed to driver methods rather than explicit self.<element> assignments.
